blocks.text: I lost twenty-nine things in four days and put up a notice for each one. This is the whole stack, in order. The last one is a different kind of notice.

rows.text: The left page is the notice, with a picture of the thing. The right page is where it happened. The thing is in there, looking exactly like its picture. Find it.
Every notice lists four other things that are in there too. Find those if you have the time. I didn’t.
There is a cat in every picture. The cat is not lost. She was there every time, she saw where everything went, and she isn’t saying.

blocks.text: The answers are at the back. Check your pockets first.

elements.text: Six things to find in every picture. Thirty-four in the last one.

blocks.text: In this bed. I can hear it.
Hit twice. On what, I don’t know.
The tablet. The calculator. Half a chocolate bar.
Where everything was, in order. Look only when you have truly given up.
